title: Conditional κ = 0.001371428043382419: nonuniform asynchronous whole owners (+1.011% over #505)
body:

Explicit `--reuse-local` checks the completed local receipt and every published input pin, then freshly verifies this new composition. The frozen integer order and literal owner map are the verification inputs; no floating timestamps or optimizer are trusted during verification.

Inherited all-size compiler, mutable-basis/common-label, #484 Lemma A spectator realization, restored-row, precision/tape and analytic-transfer conditions remain. #505's sufficient complete-call scheduling lemma is retained. This is a conditional finite witness, not an unconditional multiplication theorem, a new Lean proof or a global optimum. Larger disputed split-residual claims use a different interface.
